text:
alex_cs: Hi — customer AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 503s hitting hosted inference since ~2026-03-17T11:03Z. They see request timeouts and some responses fail mid-stream. Attached request IDs and a heap of sample logs. They're escalated and pushing for repro steps / ETA. :exclamation:
mike_oncall: looking now. any pattern on model/route?
alex_cs: all hits are to /v1/chat -> model=redwood-large, route=prod-eu, qps ~200 for their org key. They said errors spike during longer prompts (>12k tokens).
sara_runtime: can you paste a sample request id? I'll grep runner logs.
alex_cs: request id rID=acme-20260317-11-04-4821. customer log snippet: "status":503, "error":"upstream error: inference runner aborted"
sara_runtime: found entries around 11:04. log tail from infer-runner: ```[2026-03-17T11:04:12.421Z] infer-runner[pid=2345]: runtime abort (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8b3c1a2d3e
[2026-03-17T11:04:12.427Z] infer-runner[pid=2345]: coredump written to /var/crash/infer/2345.core
[2026-03-17T11:04:12.430Z] orchestrator: container restart (exit_code=139)
```
lina_infra: nvml shows GPU memory pressure around same timeframe. snippet from node: `E NVML: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and `GPU 0 memory used 15.8 GiB / 16 GiB` — looks like OOM on heavy context.
james_ml: model redwood-large typical working set ~13-14GiB but with long context KV can spike. Did routing fallback to a quantized variant?
alex_cs: customer says they see no fallback; they expect system to degrade to smaller model.
mike_oncall: check routing logs for that org key. if policy pinned to dedicated high-throughput pool, fallback may be disabled.
sara_runtime: quick repro command (using their prompt skeleton): ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<12k_token_prompt_here>","stream":false}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
I ran it against a canary and triggered the same abort in 2/10 attempts — reproduces under heavy prefetched KV.
lina_infra: can we get gcore / coredump analysis? i pulled the core, running `gdb -ex "thread apply all bt full" -ex quit --batch /opt/infer/bin/runner /var/crash/infer/2345.core` — backtrace shows entry in attention kernel in CUDA, followed by `Invalid device pointer` then sigsegv.
sara_runtime: stack indicates kernel saw an out-of-bounds pointer after an attempted allocation. nvprof shows an allocation failure then subsequent kernel execution. sequence: allocate KV cache -> allocation errored but kernel launched -> segfault.
james_ml: likely a race where allocation failure isn't checked before launching kernels. we should add a guard to abort before kernel invocation. I can prototype a guard quick.
mike_oncall: short-term mitigation for customer: 1) reduce max_context_size on their org route to 8k, 2) enable fallback routing to redwood-medium-quant for this key, 3) if possible throttle concurrent requests per-org. can ops apply a temporary route override?
lina_infra: i can push a route override to set max_context=8192 and force fallback=true for org=acme in prod-eu. will do now.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: route-override/org=acme -> max_context=8192, fallback=true (canary=10% hosts) :rocket:
mike_oncall: after canary we need to watch p50/p95 latencies and 5xx rate. please monitor metrics dashboard (route=prod-eu, org=acme).
alex_cs: forwarded mitigation to customer — they asked for ETA on fix.
james_ml: i'll open a small runtime PR to check allocation return codes before kernel launch and add a defensive early-return to trigger graceful fallback. target PR today EOW.
sara_runtime: collecting repro artifacts and uploading to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1764009999/acme-repro/. includes core, nvml logs, runner logs, and the curl repro.
lina_infra: canary override is live on 10% at 11:20Z. monitoring shows error rate dropped from 18%->3% for acme traffic on canary hosts.
mike_oncall: good sign. escalate eng-runtime for patch and eng-ml to review routing policy that disables fallback for high-tier customers.
james_ml: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/1427 — adds allocation checks + metrics when allocation fails. requesting review from @sara_runtime and @lina_infra.
alex_cs: customer happy with mitigation for now, asked us to keep them updated. also asked about billing credits for the outage window — passing to finance.
mike_oncall: action items: [sara_runtime] attach coredump analysis in PR, [james_ml] land guard and quick rollback path, [lina_infra] widen canary to 50% if metrics stay good, [alex_cs] coordinate credit conversation.
sara_runtime: attaching backtrace summary and repro notes in the PR and incident bucket. :white_check_mark:
lina_infra: canary to 50% at 11:40Z — no regression observed. expanding to 100% in 15m unless objections.
mike_oncall: no objections. after rollout, we'll keep elevated alerting on this route for 24h.
alex_cs: thanks team — i'll close the CS loop once finance confirms credit. please add postmortem notes after patch lands. :pray:
